new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/harvested")
                .withSecure(true)
                .withSocketAddress(
                        new SocketAddress()
                                .withHost("some_host")
                                .withPort(9090)
                                .withScheme(SocketAddress.Scheme.HTTPS)
                ),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("<uuid>")
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(200)
);
